final: WITH visit_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as visit_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), total_visits AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL), shares AS (SELECT vc.ID, vc.visit_count, CAST(vc.visit_count AS REAL) / tv.total as share FROM visit_counts vc, total_visits tv), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg FROM shares) SELECT s.ID, s.visit_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg as difference FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg ORDER BY difference DESC, (difference IS NULL) ASC LIMIT 10
